mentions.name: bonsai
mentions.description: A voxel engine built from scratch over ten years of spare-time work, including custom memory allocators, a font rasterizer, a programming language, collision detection, a renderer, and gameplay code.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on a voxel engine in my spare time for 10 years, this year.  I wrote everything from scratch, from the memory allocators,  font rasterizer and a programing language all the way to collision detection, renderer and gameplay code. It's been a journey!
